name: stage_1_stand_60s
description: Permissive standing bootstrap. Auto-advance after 60 sec continuous upright (3600 ticks @ 60Hz). Full standing reward density, no walking signal yet — brain commits to standing pose before navigation reward kicks in.

name: stage_2_walk_over_there_progress
description:
Phase 7.12 terminal stage — walk_over_there with progress-PB reward.

Reward landscape:
  standing baseline:       0.05 hits/tick  (reduced standing — body must move to earn full reward)
  walking (to_target):     up to 0.05 hits/tick when velocity points toward target
  gated bonus (chassis_y x v_toward_target): up to 0.10 hits/tick
  PROGRESS-PB:             events.hit fires with intensity = (PB - new_dist) × 50
                            ONLY when distance to target reaches a new minimum
                            cannot be Goodharted by orbital drift — must close distance
  visit bonus on arrival:  5.0 (existing)

Progress reward at 1cm new-PB step with gain=50 → 0.5 hits intensity per crossing.
Gain=50 means 0.5 hits per 1cm closer-than-ever-before progress.

random_pyramid target_mode rotates to a new random pyramid each arrival. PB resets on rotation.
